req.zh: 隔离程序、演练记录、审批模板
req.en: Isolation procedures, drill records and approval templates

p.zh: 评估事件对船舶运营、安全与合规的实际影响。
p.en: Assesses the actual impact of an incident on vessel operations, safety and compliance.

rows.zh: 船岸数据交换中断 4 小时
rows.en: Ship-shore data exchange interrupted for 4 hours

rows.zh: 无直接安全后果，但涉及航行数据完整性
rows.en: No direct safety consequence, but voyage data integrity is involved

req.zh: 影响评估表、纠正措施关闭证据
req.en: Impact assessment forms and corrective action closure evidence

p.zh: 定义从恢复到正常运行的步骤与目标时间。
p.en: Defines the steps from recovery to normal operation and the target times.

rows.zh: 从离线备份还原 → 配置比对 → 功能测试 → 复位
rows.en: Restore from offline backup → compare configuration → functional test → reset

rows.zh: 需要完整备份 + 厂商在场
rows.en: Requires a complete backup + the vendor on site

rows.zh: 切换冗余链路 → 配置下发 → 连通性验证
rows.en: Fail over to the redundant link → push configuration → verify connectivity

rows.zh: 从系统映像还原 → AD 恢复 → 策略复核
rows.en: Restore from system image → recover AD → re-check policy

req.zh: 恢复计划、备份策略、责任人
req.en: Recovery plan, backup strategy and responsibilities

p.zh: 记录恢复演练的实际结果与耗时。
p.en: Records the actual result and elapsed time of recovery drills.

req.zh: 恢复测试记录、耗时对比、失败项整改
req.en: Recovery test records, elapsed time comparison and failure remediation

p.zh: 登记备份对象、频率与介质，区分船岸两侧。
p.en: Registers backup targets, frequency and media, separately for ship and shore.

rows.zh: 每日增量 + 每周全量
虚拟化存储 + 独立备份服务器

req.zh: 备份台账、校验记录、异地保存证明
req.en: Backup register, verification records and offsite storage evidence

p.zh: 定期从备份恢复并验证 —— 没恢复过的备份不算备份。
p.en: Periodically restores from backup and verifies — a backup never restored is not a backup.

req.zh: 恢复测试记录、失败项分析与整改
req.en: Restore test records, failure analysis and remediation

p.zh: 记录冗余设计及其独立性 —— 冗余但共享依赖等于没有冗余。
p.en: Records redundancy designs and their independence — redundancy sharing dependencies is not redundancy.

rows.zh: 独立电源 + 独立配置
机房供电（已核实为不同回路）
同型固件漏洞会同时命中（见漏洞管理）
rows.en: A firmware flaw in the same model hits both at once (see Vulnerability Management)

req.zh: 冗余设计说明、共因失效分析
req.en: Redundancy design notes and common-cause failure analysis

p.zh: 记录回滚步骤、前置条件与实测耗时。
p.en: Records rollback steps, preconditions and measured elapsed time.

rows.zh: 导入镜像 → 重启 → 校验 → 复位
导入备份 → 重载 → 验证连通性
降级固件 → 清除配置 → 恢复参数
rows.en: Downgrade firmware → clear configuration → restore parameters

req.zh: 回滚程序、演练记录、镜像留存证明
req.en: Rollback procedures, drill records and image custody evidence

p.zh: 记录系统降级运行时的最低功能集合与人工替代方案。
p.en: Records the minimum viable function set under degraded operation and the manual fallbacks.

rows.zh: 维持推进与电力人工监视
rows.en: Maintain manual watch on propulsion and power

rows.zh: 轮机员定时抄表 + 无线电报
rows.en: Engineers read gauges on a schedule + radio reports

rows.zh: 卫星电话 + 纸质日报

req.zh: 持续运行安排、业务方确认签字
req.en: Continuity of operations arrangements with business sign-off

p.zh: 把事件与演练的教训转成具体的改进项。
p.en: Turns the lessons from incidents and drills into concrete improvement items.

rows.zh: 口令强度不足导致暴力破解成功
rows.en: Weak password policy allowed a successful brute force

rows.zh: Zone 2 强制 MFA + 口令策略补强
rows.en: Enforce MFA in Zone 2 + strengthen password policy

rows.zh: 上线前无漏洞扫描环节
发布清单增加扫描关卡
rows.en: Add a scan gate to the release checklist

rows.zh: 边界失效时无人工切换流程
rows.en: No manual failover procedure when the boundary fails

req.zh: 经验教训记录、改进项关闭证据
req.en: Lessons learned records and improvement closure evidence

p.zh: 按检验场景一键装配证据包，避免检验当天临时找材料。
p.en: Assembles the evidence for a survey scenario in one click, so nothing is hunted for on the day.

rows.zh: 推进 / 操舵 / 电力 / 消防
导航 / 通信 / 链路
域控 / 邮件 / 终端
拓扑 + 规则 + 访问记录

req.zh: 证据包导出件、目录清单与校验值
req.en: Exported evidence packages with index and checksums

p.zh: 登记每一条证据的来源、生成时间与所属模块。
p.en: Registers each evidence item with its source, generation time and owning module.

req.zh: 证据条目清单、校验值清单
req.en: Evidence item register with checksums

p.zh: 记录历次检验的发现项与整改闭环。
p.en: Records findings from each survey and their remediation closure.

req.zh: 检验报告、发现项与整改闭环证据
req.en: Survey reports with finding and closure evidence

p.zh: 建立条款 → 模块 → 证据的映射，回答「这一条拿什么证明」。
p.en: Maps clause → module → evidence — the answer to 'what proves this clause'.

req.zh: 条款映射表、缺口清单
req.en: Clause mapping table and gap list

p.zh: 记录人员培训与资质，以及证书到期。
p.en: Records staff training and qualifications, including certificate expiry.

rows.zh: OT 安全意识 + 事件响应
CBS 变更管理与最小功能

req.zh: 培训记录、证书扫描件、缺口清单
req.en: Training records, certificate scans and gap list

p.zh: 记录组织架构、职责边界与外部接口人。
p.en: Records the organisational structure, responsibility boundaries and external points of contact.

rows.zh: 整体安全策略、事件响应、检验对接
rows.en: Overall security policy, incident response, survey liaison

rows.zh: 船上 CBS 运行、变更执行、隔离决策
rows.en: Ship-side CBS operation, change execution, isolation decisions

rows.zh: 设备与平台运行、备份、采集
rows.en: Device and platform operation, backup, collection

rows.zh: 批准高风险变更、对外沟通

req.zh: 组织架构图、职责矩阵、代理人安排
req.en: Organisation chart, responsibility matrix and deputy arrangements

p.zh: 记录所有写操作与敏感读取 —— 敏感读取同样要留痕。
p.en: Records every write and sensitive read — a sensitive read is an audit event too.

req.zh: 审计日志导出、只追加证明、留存策略
req.en: Audit log export, append-only evidence and retention policy
